steps.what: Find relevant professional organizations and continuing education activities
Participate in continuing education and professional discussion to improve knowledge and skills
Enter actual completed continuing education evidence in the existing learning portfolio

tasks.design: Link current learning opportunities to the existing {LMS} portfolio and reuse stable activity references. The nurse chooses the activity, participates fully and records actual completion evidence after it exists.
tasks.previous_blocker: Course references are searched and copied separately into the professional portfolio.
tasks.enabler_now: Native course links and reusable portfolio fields remove small clerical repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Participation must lead to genuine learning rather than merely a completion flag.
tasks.human_edge: Reflect on what applies to critical care and question uncertain teaching.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native learning portfolios can reuse activity references, but actual education and professional discussion remain human work.

assumptions: Boundary is an actual professional learning episode with the nurse's existing portfolio, used for development and competence review. Informal organization participation without a portfolio requirement does not acquire a new record.

The provider produces activity id, title, date and completion evidence after attendance; the nurse enters actual completion and reflection in s3. Missing provider evidence is handled manually, never inferred from enrolment.

s1 removes1.5 units of navigation. s3 removes one unit of repeated course references, retaining nine for evidence and reflection. Ordinary same-system save is negligible, ungated and unchanged; existing automatic completion capture earns no benefit.
unknowns: Which learning activities require actual portfolio entry
Whether the provider already records completion directly
research_questions: Can native links reuse references without recording completion before attendance?

already_counted.description: Find and read activity details, participate and record actual learning evidence

incremental.description: Repair course links and portfolio defaults

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R97.5 gross2.5 less upkeep1 gives1.5. For an external organization without compatible activity references, lookup retains9 of10 and portfolio entry10 of10; participation80 stays. Gross1 less upkeep1 gives0.

steps.what: Read current nursing practice protocols and source evidence
Evaluate nursing practice protocol options with clinical colleagues
Write the proposed nursing protocol amendments and evidence rationale

loop.purpose: Draft the selected protocol amendment and its rationale
loop.input: Clinician-selected changes and opened source passages
loop.output: Draft with each change linked to a source or explicitly marked local decision
loop.check: Nurse checks clinical meaning, scope, exceptions, contraindications and evidence applicability, not only citation existence
loop.stop: Unsupported clinical change or conflicting evidence requires manual drafting and existing expert resolution; one redraft maximum
loop.why_not_simpler: Irregular clinical reasoning cannot be expressed by merging identifiers alone

steps.what: Check the final proposed nursing protocol amendment for committee submission
Submit the checked proposed nursing protocol amendment to the existing protocol committee
Save the proposed nursing protocol version in the same working folder

tasks.design: Group the current protocol and selected evidence in {DOCS}, then draft only clinician-selected changes with a bounded source-linked loop. The nurse checks the full proposal before a separate {EMAIL} submission to the existing committee; publication as an operative protocol stays with its actual governance authority.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence navigation and repeated amendment writing slow contributions to protocol review.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source links plus bounded drafting can reuse the actual evidence without choosing the clinical change.
tasks.still_hard: Source applicability and safe local practice require multidisciplinary clinical judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize when a generic recommendation is inappropriate for critical care patients.

ambition.what: Submit a source-linked comparison of one proposed protocol exception for committee deliberation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-linked drafting can shorten protocol amendment writing, but clinical evaluation and operative approval remain human governance work.

assumptions: Boundary is the nurse's actual participation, written proposal and submission for committee consideration. It does not release a new protocol or grant the author approval authority; downstream committee deliberation and release receive no claimed saving.

The evidence source authors produce the source text; the nurse reads and selects it in s1 and records actual clinical choices in s3. No model-generated source, automatic clinical recommendation or free transcript is assumed. Extra input and failed drafts are funded below.

s1 removes five units of document switching, retaining twenty of source reading. s3 retains eighteen units of source-based writing and checks, plus the full final ten-unit submission check. Native templates are tested first.
s4 authorizes the exact proposal's delivery to the committee, not adoption of its contents. Any changed text, attachments or recipient voids it. The ordinary save is tiny, fully retained and ungated.
unknowns: How much amendment prose must be rewritten
Whether native evidence links already remove navigation
research_questions: Do reviewers find any changed clinical meaning despite correct source references?

already_counted.description: Read evidence, evaluate clinically, review draft meaning, check final submission and save

incremental.description: Repair difficult amendments and source links and handle failed committee delivery

approvals.approved_version: Exact proposed protocol amendment, evidence attachments and committee recipient checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R79 gross21 less upkeep4 gives17. For conflicting evidence with no reusable amendment structure, source25 and drafting27 of30 remain, with evaluation30, final check10 and save1. R93 gross7 less upkeep4 gives3, including actual four-unit proposal delivery.

steps.what: Clarify the patient care conference purpose and necessary participants
Compare participant availability and room slots for the care conference
Write the actual patient care conference agenda and proposed invitation
Check the final patient care conference invitation, participants and permitted disclosure
Send the checked care conference invitation to the exact authorized participants
Resolve participants' practical care conference attendance questions
Save the care conference agenda in its existing document location

tasks.design: Use native availability matching in {CALENDAR} and stable headings for the actual agenda in {DOCS}. The nurse determines who needs to participate and checks the complete invitation's disclosure and destination before its separate send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual availability comparison and repeated agenda details consume coordination time.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing calendar availability and agenda templates can handle the fixed clerical parts.
tasks.still_hard: The right people, patient preferences and urgent care priorities need clinical coordination.
tasks.human_edge: Include the people needed for a useful and respectful care discussion.

ambition.what: Clinical and patient participation decisions remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: availability matching is deterministic, while care-conference participation and confidential disclosure require human checks.

assumptions: Boundary is actual conference coordination and invitation, including practical attendance clarification. The conference's clinical discussion and post-conference care decisions are separate work; no fictitious conference minutes are added here.

This episode includes an authorized participant outside the organization, so the invitation is act_external. The nurse determines the actual list in s1; calendar owners maintain available slots. Missing external availability is obtained manually within retained coordination and incremental repair.

s3 removes three units of repeated meeting headings and references, retaining seventeen for actual agenda and privacy-sensitive wording. The ordinary agenda save is tiny, fully retained and ungated. Existing calendar matching runtime earns no new benefit.

s4 checks exact agenda, date, place, participants and disclosure after the invitation exists. Any change voids the gate and returns to s4 before reissue. s6 is attendance clarification, not permission for unreviewed changed invitations.
unknowns: Who is authorized to receive patient-identifying content
research_questions: Can the invitation contain the minimum necessary information while still enabling useful attendance?

already_counted.description: Clarify purpose, write actual agenda, check disclosure, resolve attendance questions and save

incremental.description: Manually repair missing availability, changed invitations and failed delivery; maintain agenda fields

approvals.approved_version: Exact conference agenda, time, place, participants and patient disclosure checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R63 gross37 less upkeep4 gives33. For external participants without compatible availability metadata, slot comparison retains25 of30 and agenda19 of20; purpose20, privacy check15, clarification10 and save1 remain. R90 gross10 less upkeep4 gives6.

tasks.short: Plan and provide a nursing education session

steps.what: Determine the educational program's audience needs and appropriate learning objectives
Read vetted educational source material for the selected objectives
Write the educational session outline, examples and teaching prompts

loop.input: Nurse-selected objectives, audience level and vetted source passages
loop.output: Outline and examples linked to source passages
loop.check: Nurse verifies clinical correctness, audience suitability, caveats and each example's meaning against the sources
loop.stop: Unsupported advice, changed clinical meaning or unsuitable level requires manual writing; one redraft maximum
loop.why_not_simpler: Adapting source explanations to a particular audience requires prose beyond fixed headings

steps.what: Check the full educational session for clinical accuracy and teaching suitability
Provide the educational session and respond to participants' questions
Evaluate the educational program through participants' actual understanding and feedback

tasks.design: Link vetted teaching sources in {DOCS} and draft only the nurse-selected objectives into the existing education format. The nurse checks every clinical explanation, teaches in person and evaluates actual participant understanding.
tasks.previous_blocker: Audience-appropriate examples and session wording are repeatedly prepared from source material.
tasks.enabler_now: A source-bound drafting loop can propose an outline and examples without choosing the learning need or clinical advice.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding and useful behaviour change need live teaching and observation.
tasks.human_edge: Notice confusion and adapt the explanation while maintaining clinical accuracy.

ambition.what: Prepare a checked introductory version for new interdisciplinary team members.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-bound educational drafting can reduce preparation effort, but clinical correctness, live instruction and understanding checks remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is a nurse-led education session within existing professional competence, including actual preparation and live evaluation. It does not release a new clinical protocol, diagnose a participant or grant a qualification. No unused education report is invented.

The approved source owners produce current source text; the nurse chooses objectives in s1 and reads the source in s2. No patient data or free recording is required. Participant understanding is assessed in the actual session, not inferred by a model.

s2 removes two units of source navigation, retaining eight of reading. s3 retains12.5 of25 for meaningful checking and correction plus a full ten-unit final teaching check. Existing templates are tested first; extra draft repair is funded below.

Ordinary document save within drafting is negligible, unchanged and ungated. No material publication or certificate send is promised. If the actual programme needs a separate specialist review or formal release, its real labour and gate must be mapped before deployment.
unknowns: Which educational topics lie within the nurse's actual teaching authority
research_questions: Do examples preserve the source's clinical caveats and audience level?

already_counted.description: Choose objectives, read sources, check draft meaning, teach and evaluate actual understanding

incremental.description: Maintain source templates and repair difficult or outdated teaching drafts

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R85.5 gross14.5 less upkeep3 gives11.5. For an unfamiliar audience needing nearly bespoke examples, source reading retains8 of10 and draft work23 of25; needs20, final check10, teaching25 and evaluation10 remain. R96 gross4 less upkeep3 gives1.

Configure existing learning and calendar fields
